note: Maps the first two digits of the four-digit department code on a contract (tender.procuringEntity, urn:marin:organization:department:NNNN) to a department. 'budgetCode' is the department's budget code (local:marin-budget-department-code in organizations.jsonld). Groups with no budgetCode have no organization page yet. The prefix rule is an observed pattern (1002 -> 100 Health and Human Services, 4102 -> 410 Public Works), checked by hand for the prefixes below; sub-codes such as 1001 to 1005 are not yet matched to divisions, so they roll up to the department. Edit this file, not the output.
